title: 6.1 Ecology Basics
description: Definition of ecology, key ecological terms, biotic and abiotic components of the environment

questions.question: What is the scientific study of the interactions between living organisms and their environment called?
Which term refers to the specific place where an organism lives?
What term describes the functional role or position of an organism in its environment, including how it gets food and interacts with others?
What is a group of individuals of the same species living in a particular area called?
What term describes all the different populations of various species living and interacting in a given area?
What is a biological community of interacting organisms and their physical environment called?
Which of the following is a large community of plants and animals occupying a major habitat, such as a tropical rainforest?
What is the highest level of ecological organization, encompassing all of Earth's ecosystems?
Which of the following is an example of a biotic component of an ecosystem?
Which of the following is an example of an abiotic component of an ecosystem?
Organisms that can produce their own food using sunlight or chemical energy are called:
What is another name for autotrophs in an ecosystem?
Which type of organism cannot make its own food and must obtain energy by consuming other organisms?
What do you call an animal that feeds exclusively on plants?
Which of the following is an example of a carnivore?
An organism that feeds on both plants and animals is called a(n):
Which of the following is an example of an omnivore?
Organisms that break down dead organic matter into simpler substances are called:
Which term refers to decomposers like bacteria and fungi that feed on dead organic matter?
Which abiotic factor is the primary energy source for nearly all ecosystems on Earth?
The measure of acidity or alkalinity in soil or water that affects organism distribution is called:
What term describes the salt concentration in water, which determines whether an aquatic environment is freshwater or marine?
Which two processes carried out by living organisms help maintain the balance of oxygen and carbon dioxide in the atmosphere?
Which of the following best describes the relationship between a habitat and a niche?
options: A niche is where an organism lives; a habitat is what it does
A habitat is the role of a species in a community
A habitat is where an organism lives; a niche is what it does

questions.question: Which statement about decomposers is correct?
options: They recycle nutrients by breaking down dead matter
They are always at the top of the food chain
They feed only on living organisms
